name: Dated-futures cash and carry
hypothesis: Buy cash and short an economically matched future if all legs are permitted.
data: synchronized executable depth on every leg
spec: Setup: A dated future trades rich to cash after financing and contract settlement adjustments. Entry: Buy cash and short an economically matched future if all legs are permitted. Exit: Converge/unwind under a defined plan; exit if basis, margin or financing violates limits. Parameters to pre-register: expiry, financing_curve, contract_multiplier, basis_threshold.
blocked_reason: needs prefunded inventory on several venues and synchronized multi-leg execution
